about: Owner fills `models` before `report`: USD per million tokens, copied from the provider's official pricing page on the date in checked_on (the day you read it). Keys are provider:model exactly as `run` prints them. No prompt-caching or batch discount is assumed. While a model's price is null, `plan` and `run` show an UPPER BOUND from `fallback` below. Model versions actually served are recorded per call in runs/<run>/items.jsonl (model_served). Prices change: the report and the spoken lines always say the date.

fallback.about: CONSERVATIVE UPPER BOUND, NOT AN OFFICIAL PRICE. Deliberately high per-million-token prices used only to show a worst-case dollar figure before the owner fills `models`; the owner may override. The bound also assumes every call uses its full output cap (MAX_TOKENS = 2000). Same convention as HMD-021.
